title: -느라고 causa negativa/restricción
part: Relaciones lógicas y modalidad básica — 논리 관계와 기본 양태
articleMarkdown:
#### En pocas palabras

The NIKL guide records **-느라고** with a reason/result relation and examples such as **수지는 공부하느라고 요즘 정말 바빠요**. It notes that the form commonly occurs in excuse-like contexts. This entry is limited to the documented form and examples rather than a claim that every use has negative polarity.

#### Fuentes y localizadores

National Institute of Korean Language. (s. f.). *한국어교육 문법·표현 내용 개발 연구(3단계) [Research on the Development of Korean Grammar and Expression Content (Stage 3)]*. https://www.korean.go.kr/common/download.do;front=B5CD4F10151810563982D51A3FD4329B?c_file_name=5a2db2bc-a7ad-49f4-84a4-34b20ad33ffc_0.pdf&file_path=reportData&o_file_name=%ED%95%9C%EA%B5%AD%EC%96%B4%EA%B5%90%EC%9C%A1+%EB%AC%B8%EB%B2%95%ED%91%9C%ED%98%84+%EB%82%B4%EC%9A%A9%EA%B0%9C%EB%B0%9C+%EC%97%B0%EA%B5%AC_3%EB%8B%A8%EA%B3%84.pdf

Research on the Development of Korean Grammar and Expression Content (Stage 3), PDF pp. 158–159 (printed pp. 146–147): formation, examples, and usage note for -느라고.

#### Entradas relacionadas

Se relaciona con **때문에**, **-아/어서**, **-(으)ㄴ/는 바람에** y **-(으)므로**. Todas pueden establecer relaciones causales, pero difieren en restricciones gramaticales, registro y matiz discursivo.
